notes: Dry-stone causeway (two battered wings with three creek culverts) and a central battered gatehouse with a corbelled cornice. A front stair leads to a doorway that passes through the tower front to back. The scale bar is about 47 px/m on the front view, giving roughly 22 m long, 5.7 m tall and 9.8 m deep. The views disagree a little: the back view is drawn smaller and its culverts are taller, and the top and side views show a deeper tower base than the front implies. Culvert and door heights are therefore split front-half/back-half to fit both elevations.
